annotations.title: Add a person to the CRM

description: Add a person to the customer's connected CRM. It looks the person up from the profile link, e-mail or name given, checks the CRM first so nobody is added twice, and saves what it found with the customer's usual field settings and default tags. A record with the same name is reported as a possible match and nothing is added until add_anyway is set. Uses one lookup credit when an e-mail address is found.

add_anyway.description: true to add the person although a possible match exists, once that match is known to be a different person

company.description: the company the person works for

email.description: an e-mail address the person is known by

include_phone.description: also look for a mobile number; this uses extra credits, so set it only when the customer wants a phone number saved

name.description: the person's full name; give it with a company when there is no profile link or e-mail

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile page

tags.description: tags to put on the record, in addition to the customer's default tags

use_email.description: one of the addresses found, to save as the person's main e-mail instead of the best one

name: add_person_to_crm

contact.description: what was found for the person and saved

company_is_current.description: false when the employer shown may no longer be current

status.description: how sure we are the address is deliverable (verified, likely, unverified, risky)

domain.description: the employer's website domain, when known

not_offered_emails.description: addresses held but not offered as current, with the reason

reason.description: why it is not offered: left_employer, other_employer or undeliverable

number.description: the phone number in international format

profile_url.description: link to the person's public professional profile

crm.description: the CRM the person was added to, or checked

not_saved.description: fields the CRM did not take, when any

possible_matches.description: records that share the person's name and may or may not be the same person

company_match.description: for a possible match: whether the record's company agrees with the one given

email_conflict.description: true when the record holds an e-mail address that none of the person's known addresses matches, which argues against it being the same person

entity_type.description: contact or lead, in CRMs that have both

match.description: profile_link, email or confirmed for a certain match; name for a possible one

profile_url.description: the public profile link the record holds, when it holds one

record_id.description: the record's id in the CRM; pass it to get_crm_record, update_crm_record or log_crm_activity

url.description: link to the record in the CRM; share it with the customer

record.description: the new record, or the one already there

company_match.description: for a possible match: whether the record's company agrees with the one given

email_conflict.description: true when the record holds an e-mail address that none of the person's known addresses matches, which argues against it being the same person

entity_type.description: contact or lead, in CRMs that have both

profile_url.description: the public profile link the record holds, when it holds one

record_id.description: the record's id in the CRM; pass it to get_crm_record, update_crm_record or log_crm_activity

url.description: link to the record in the CRM; share it with the customer

status.description: added, already_in_crm, possible_matches, not_found or pending
